description:
Uninstall Windows programs with removal guidance, a restore-point attempt and a local removal receipt.

PC Tweaker Uninstaller lists detected desktop programs and Microsoft Store packages, with removal-risk guidance and reasons for each assessment. Before removal, it shows the command and requested permissions and can request a Windows restore point when supported and permitted.
A local removal receipt records the program, method, outcome, exit code, pending reboot and restore-point request. A request is not proof that Windows created a restore point. Review the outcome before relying on it.
Single uninstalls, leftover scans, file/folder cleanup to the Recycle Bin and supported cleanup Undo are free. Uninstaller Pro adds batch removal and registry-key/startup-entry cleanup; the Plans & pricing page in the app compares both plans. Leftover detection does not guarantee complete removal; review each proposed item before deleting it. Cleanup Undo does not reinstall a removed application or replace an independent backup.
- The selection bar no longer covers the buttons of a confirmation.
- The batch confirmation shows long program names clearly.
- Confirmations open with the keyboard on Cancel.
- Sizes switch to MB and GB at 1000.
- Smaller contrast and label fixes.
